allowed: MRI-before pairs and T1/FLAIR/beforeUS arrays, proper rigid baseline diagnostic and fixed source-plane display derivatives

fit.LOO: each baseline row once; all remaining rows train, no tuning
fit.bounds: each source/destination inside its original full-cell grid [-0.5,shape-0.5]
fit.interpretation: Baseline calibration and leave-one-out diagnostics, not independent V or clinical accuracy. Poor LOO retained, no fallback fit

views.T1_FLAIR: three FLAIR native planes at rounded median MRI-reference voxel location; T1 sampled by original affines
views.US_FLAIR: three beforeUS native planes at rounded median US-reference voxel location; raw and fitted FLAIR comparisons
views.sampling: 2D trilinear display pixels only, NaN outsideFOV; no resampledNIfTI
views.contrast: fixed stride3 all-voxel finite 1st/99th percentiles, not brainmask

acceptance.frame_semantics: Creator common MINC/NIfTI world plus native sform millimetres and official RAS convention
acceptance.visual_QC: Record gross orientation/FOV/mismatch after all fixed panels; no expertapproval

preparation_note: Supervision-only termination grace after preserved V2 failure; no new patient run authorized and no scientific setting changed.

prior_attempt.observation: Valid ps response contained childRSS0 state?E while directpolls remainedNone; exit0 later. No ps-state-only acceptance.

monitor_v2.child_exit_confirmation: subprocess.poll after query; ps state alone does not establish exit
monitor_v2.missing_or_zero_RSS: fail if worker remains alive; allow absent/zero worker row only when direct poll confirms exited and parent sample valid
monitor_v2.malformed_or_failed_query: retain failure even if worker exited

monitor_v3.eligibility: Valid PID/RSS response, positive parent RSS, absent/zero child RSS, direct poll stillNone
monitor_v3.confirmation: process.wait must confirm termination within min(0.05,remaining work deadline); ps state never proves exit
monitor_v3.work_deadline: overall wall cap minus0.25s cleanup reserve; query and grace timeouts bounded by work deadline
monitor_v3.cleanup: SIGKILL when stillalive; wait bounded by remaining overall wall cap; unconfirmed cleanup fails
